title: chat-server /set handlers skip accountNotFound check
description: RFC 8620 §3.6.2: an unknown accountId is a method-level accountNotFound error. jmap-chat-server's custom /set handlers (chat.rs handle_chat_set, message.rs, space.rs, contact.rs, invite.rs, ban.rs, emoji.rs ...) never call JmapBackend::account_exists (0 call sites in crate-jmap-chat-server/src), while the generic jmap-server handle_get/changes/query do (crate-jmap-server/src/handlers.rs:155-161). Proof at HEAD 05a30464: tests/integration.rs chat_set_create_group uses a fresh MemoryBackend::new() with no register_account and Chat/set succeeds, because MemoryBackend::create_object (memory.rs ~1043) inserts into known_accounts. Result: /set silently materialises an account that /get had reported as accountNotFound. Fix: add the account_exists gate to every chat /set (and other custom) handler, mirroring mail-server; ~167 chat tests across ~60 files rely on implicit registration and need register_account fixtures. Blocks the chat half of JMAP-38f3.
